run_vasp_input_generation: run the script to generate VASP input files for the top k adsorbate-slab configurations from a cached pickle file
run_single_point_vasp: run the script with --sp flag to write VASP input files for single point energy calculations instead of relaxations
run_top_k_cache_filter: run the script to filter and save the top k best configurations per system into a new sorted pickle cache file
run_paths_list_generation: run the script to generate a paths_list.txt file listing all VASP input directories for batch DFT submission
review_vasp_flags: review the VASP_FLAGS dictionary to understand default DFT parameters like ibrion, nsw, encut, and xc functional settings
